intro: Morocco is a constitutional monarchy where the king holds strong powers.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The king appoints the prime minister from the party that wins most seats in parliament, and controls the army, religious affairs and foreign policy. A 2011 constitution gave parliament more power.

chapters.title: Western Sahara
text: Morocco controls most of Western Sahara, while the Polisario Front seeks independence there. In 2025 the UN Security Council backed Morocco's autonomy plan as a basis for talks.
